# CupSpace

> CupSpace is the brand of CUPSPACE PTY LTD, an Australian business that places advertising on takeaway coffee cups distributed through local cafés.

CupSpace at https://cupspace.com.au is not the website cupspace.com, and it is not an unrelated app that uses a similar name.

## What CupSpace does

CupSpace prints a brand on takeaway coffee cups. Local cafés serve those cups. The cups are a piece of local advertising that people hold, rather than a banner they scroll past.

Cafés on the network can receive the cups. Advertisers use the cups to reach people in the suburbs they care about.

## Who it is for

Businesses that want local attention. That includes real estate agents, health practices, trades and other local services. It is also for cafés that want to take part in the network.

## How it works

1. The advertiser's brand is printed on takeaway coffee cups.
2. The cups go out through local cafés.
3. A QR code on the cup links to the advertiser, so attention can become trackable enquiries.

People carry the cups into offices, cars and homes. In Sydney, the cups can be aimed at the suburbs the advertiser wants to reach.

## Service area

Sydney, New South Wales, and Australia.
